frequency_question: What proportion of major announced ministry-level automotive/transport financial incentive frameworks achieve formal final notification and implementation within a ~3-year horizon from initial conceptualization/signaling?
membership_rule: Includes: Ministry-level industrial promotion schemes, FAME-type automotive subsidies, and capital goods/heavy vehicle manufacturing incentive frameworks. Excludes: Minor administrative circulars, tax rate modifications by the revenue department, and state-level (provincial) policies.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named major flagship automotive/green transition incentive frameworks tracked over the last decade; all major announced schemes in this specific policy domain eventually reached formal notification, though some experienced timeline drift.
known_gaps: Potential smaller sub-schemes or exploratory drafts that were quietly shelved before formal public exposure are not captured in public gazette tracking.
validity_reason: The policy-making apparatus and current administration's strong emphasis on electric vehicle transition and manufacturing incentives remain stable through this period.
